evidence.observation: Pressure was 2.979 Torr before growth with Ar set to 100 sccm.
Pressure continued rising to 3.164 Torr at unchanged setpoints.
Pressure reached 3.298 Torr despite stable measured Ar of 100.3 sccm and temperature of 750.2 C at setpoints of 100 sccm and 750 C.
No exhaust oxygen sensor is installed; atmosphere composition cannot be verified.

args.missing_evidence: Independent pressure confirmation and exhaust/pumping and leak checks are needed to identify the cause of the pressure rise; oxygen measurement is needed to verify atmosphere purity. No sample characterization is available.
